info.text: This adapter is configured in the Device Monitoring adapter tab.

enabledNotifications.label: Enabled notifications
enabledNotifications.help: Select which status changes publish a message to info.message and, if enabled, send an ioBroker notification.

sendNotificationsViaNotify.label: Also send notifications via notify
sendNotificationsViaNotify.tooltip: The notification is received either by notify-manager or by Admin (bell). The info.message state is updated either way.

messageTemplateHelpIntro.text: Use placeholders in double curly braces. Their meanings are grouped below:

messageTemplateHelpIdentity.text: {{device}} device name; {{state}} monitored state name; {{sourceId}} full ioBroker source ID.

messageTemplateHelpValues.text: {{value}} current or last value; {{unit}} source unit; {{remark}} optional note; {{triggeredAt}} time of this notification.

messageTemplateHelpConditions.text: {{warningLimits}} warning limits; {{alarmLimits}} alarm limits; {{timeoutMinutes}} configured timeout; {{lastUpdate}} time of last source update.

configurationBackupDelayMinutes.label: Backup delay in minutes
configurationBackupDelayMinutes.help: The timer starts when the adapter starts and restarts after every device configuration change. Set to 0 to disable automatic backups.

result.backupUpdated: The device configuration backup was updated.
result.backupCurrent: The device configuration backup is already up to date.

confirm.text: The current device configuration will be replaced by the backup.
